cohort: 125 newborns born to mothers with COVID-19 in 34 neonatal intensive care units in Turkey
finding: COVID-19 in pregnant women was associated with important perinatal and neonatal outcomes, including higher maternal mortality, higher rates of preterm birth and cesarean section, suspected risk of vertical transmission, and low rate of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: COVID-19 in pregnant women was associated with higher rates of preterm birth and cesarean section.
